objective: Select the next workstream after closing the source-closure refusal public-pack boundary.

selection.reason: The filelist-facing flow can now expose and refuse incomplete source closure, but the operator still has to provide a long complete source list manually. The next usability gap is a reviewed way to copy source closure from a known tracked template without claiming arbitrary RTL dependency inference.
selection.primary_operator_gap: avoid repeating a large complete source list when a reviewed tracked template already carries the closure

must_define_next: an explicit operator-facing mechanism to copy source_files/source_closure from a known tracked template
the exact accepted reference template path or target
refusal behavior when the reference template is missing, untracked, incomplete, or unknown
deferred_candidates: automatic dependency inference for arbitrary RTL
materialization-time refusal expansion beyond the current guard
non_claims: not automatic dependency inference for arbitrary RTL
not proof that unknown source closure is complete
